title: OpenAI Drops NDAs for Public Officials on Data Center Projects
excerpt: OpenAI commits to new community transparency measures for data center projects, pledging not to use non-disclosure agreements with public officials.
body_html:
OpenAI has announced new commitments regarding its data center projects, specifically stating that it will no longer use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) when working with public officials.

This decision follows recent midterms where voters expressed strong opposition to the expansion of data centers. Historically, many such infrastructure projects have faced criticism and scrutiny for utilizing NDAs to keep discussions hidden from the public.

The updated approach is intended to bring more openness to communities where OpenAI is currently developing or planning data center facilities.
